        "contents": "const UploadModal: React.FC&lt;UploadModalProps&gt; = ({\n  onClose,\n  onUpload,\n  selectedCategoryId,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [file, setFile] = useState&lt;File | null&gt;(null);\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);\n  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;(null);\n\n  const handleFileSelect = (selectedFile: File) =&gt; {\n    setFile(selectedFile);\n  };\n\n  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n\n    const droppedFile = e.dataTransfer.files[0];\n    if (droppedFile) {\n      handleFileSelect(droppedFile);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFileInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const selectedFile = e.target.files?.[0];\n    if (selectedFile) {\n      handleFileSelect(selectedFile);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleUpload = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!file) {\n      alert('请选择文件');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setUploading(true);\n    try {\n      await onUpload(file, {\n        category_id: selectedCategoryId,\n        description: description.trim() || undefined,\n      });\n      // 重置表单\n      setFile(null);\n      setDescription('');\n      if (fileInputRef.current) {\n        fileInputRef.current.value = '';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('上传失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';\n    const k = 1024;\n    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];\n    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));\n    return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50\n;",

        "contents": "import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { publicKnowledgeService } from '../../services/publicKnowledgeService';\nimport {\n  CategoryTreeNode,\n  PublicKnowledgeFile,\n  CreateCategoryDTO,\n  UpdateCategoryDTO,\n  CreateFileDTO,\n} from '../../types/publicKnowledge';\nimport CategorySidebar from '../../components/publicKnowledge/CategorySidebar';\nimport FileList from '../../components/publicKnowledge/FileList';\nimport UploadModal from '../../components/publicKnowledge/UploadModal';\nimport { toast } from 'sonner';\nimport { List, Grid, ChevronDown, Plus } from 'lucide-react';\n\nconst PublicKnowledgePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [categories, setCategories] = useState&lt;CategoryTreeNode[]&gt;([]);\n  const [files, setFiles] = useState&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;([]);\n  const [selectedCategoryId, setSelectedCategoryId] = useState&lt;number | null&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showUploadModal, setShowUploadModal] = useState(false);\n  const [editingCategory, setEditingCategory] = useState&lt;CategoryTreeNode | null&gt;(null);\n  const [showCategoryForm, setShowCategoryForm] = useState(false);\n\n  // 加载分类树\n  const loadCategories = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getCategoryTree();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setCategories(response.data);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载分类失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 加载文件列表\n  const loadFiles = async (categoryId?: number | null)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const PublicKnowledgePage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载文件列表\n  const loadFiles = async (categoryId?: number | null) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles(categoryId);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setFiles(response.data);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载文件失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载文件失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 初始加载\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadCategories();\n    loadFiles();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 当选择分类改变时，重新加载文件\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n  }, [selectedCategoryId]);\n\n  // 创建分类\n  const handleCreateCategory = async (data: CreateCategoryDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.createCategory(data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类创建成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        setShowCategoryForm(false);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '创建分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('创建分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('创建分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新分类\n  const handleUpdateCategory = async (id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.updateCategory(id, data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类更新成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        setEditingCategory(null);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '更新分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('更新分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('更新分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 删除分类\n  const handleDeleteCategory = async (id: number) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const PublicKnowledgePage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 删除分类\n  const handleDeleteCategory = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除这个分类吗？删除后，该分类下的所有子分类和文件也将被删除。')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.deleteCategory(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类删除成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        if (selectedCategoryId === id) {\n          setSelectedCategoryId(null);\n        }\n        await loadFiles(selectedCategoryId === id ? null : selectedCategoryId);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '删除分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('删除分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 上传文件\n  const handleUploadFile = async (file: File, data?: CreateFileDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.uploadFile(file, {\n        ...data,\n        category_id: selectedCategoryId,\n      });\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('文件上传成功');\n        setShowUploadModal(false);\n        await loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '文件上传失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n      toast.error('文件上传失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 删除文件\n  const handleDeleteFile = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除这个文件吗？')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.deleteFile(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('文件删除成功');\n        await loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '删除文件失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除文件失败:', error);\n      toast.error('删除文件失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n;",

        "contents": "const FileList: React.FC&lt;FileListProps&gt; = ({\n  files,\n  selectedCategoryId,\n  onDeleteFile,\n  loading,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState&lt;'grid' | 'list'&gt;('grid');\n  const [previewFile, setPreviewFile] = useState&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';\n    const k = 1024;\n    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];\n    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));\n    return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];\n  };\n\n  const getFileIcon = (fileType: string) =&gt; {\n    if (fileType.startsWith('image/')) {\n      return '🖼️';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('pdf')) {\n      return '📄';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('word') || fileType.includes('document')) {\n      return '📝';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('excel') || fileType.includes('spreadsheet')) {\n      return '📊';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('powerpoint') || fileType.includes('presentation')) {\n      return '📽️';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('zip') || fileType.includes('rar')) {\n      return '📦';\n    } else {\n      return '📎';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDownload = async (file: PublicKnowledgeFile) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const blob = await publicKnowledgeService.downloadFile(file.id);\n      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const a = document.createElement('a');\n      a.href = url;\n      a.download = file.name;\n      document.body.appendChild(a);\n      a.click();\n      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n      document.body.removeChild(a);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('下载文件失败:', error);\n      alert('下载文件失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePreview = (file: PublicKnowledgeFile) =&gt; {\n    const fileUrl = publicKnowledgeService.getFileUrl(file);\n    if (file.file_type.startsWith('image/')) {\n      setPreviewFile(file);\n    } else {\n      window.open(fileUrl, '_blank');\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div\n;",

已完成以下修改：

## 修改总结

1. **添加公共知识库文件选择弹窗状态**：新增 `showPublicKnowledgeModal` 状态。

2. **修改点击事件**：将“从 http://localhost:3001/public-knowledge 选择内容文件”的点击事件从 `setShowKnowledgePointModal(true)` 改为 `setShowPublicKnowledgeModal(true)`。

3. **创建公共知识库文件选择弹窗**：
   - 搜索功能
   - 文件列表展示
   - 文件选择/取消选择
   - 已选择文件数量显示

4. **更新资源清单逻辑**：将 `type: 'knowledge_base'` 的来源信息转换为知识点格式，并显示在“已选择知识点”列表中。

5. **完善文件选择逻辑**：
   - 选择文件时添加到项目来源
   - 取消选择时删除对应的来源
   - 初始化时同步已添加的文件状态

现在点击“从 http://localhost:3001/public-knowledge 选择内容文件”会打开公共知识库文件选择弹窗，选中的文件会显示在“已选择知识点”列表中，不再显示“知识点选择-选择技术点”的弹窗。

代码已通过语法检查，可以测试。
